Useful supporting tools improve understanding, model selection, and day-to-day
workflows.

## Open-source principles and sources

OpenWALDO organizes AI openness around Weights, Artifacts, Licenses, Data, and
Origin. Independent blogs, technical writing, research papers, and historical
milestones provide context for following the field.
